startup.command: Build the frozen Dockerfile, then start Redis/Postgres from docker-compose.yml and run the Outline server with local configuration
startup.note: The root Compose file defines Redis/Postgres dependencies only; it does not define the Outline application service. Disable external auth and object storage integrations.

workload.health: HTTP health plus deterministic document API

resources.estimate: Postgres/Redis/object storage dependencies; reduced profile required
